start.text: The shift is over. I watched every sign-in, and the logs are quiet for now.
start.name: Joshua

C.text: It's Carla. Good work tonight. But quiet doesn't mean safe. They will come back, and they will not make the same mistake twice.
C.name: Carla

D.text: So let's get ready before they do. Use the Security Points you earned to [b][color=green]harden[/color][/b] our defenses.
D.name: Carla

E.text: Understood. Better defenses now means a better night later.
E.name: Joshua
